\par\smallskip
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize
Frozen image encoders without text input; mean AUROC (\%) over 600 test episodes per shot. $\Delta$CCP-A (AUROC): paired difference with its 95\% CI, the registered H1 statistic (16 of 32 configurations Holm-significant, 15 with a Bonferroni-simultaneous CI above zero).\par
OSCR and FPR95: change from COSF to CCP-A in points, computed from means rounded to two decimals; lower FPR95 is better.\par
Best: the highest test AUROC among the eight inductive baselines (settings chosen on valA, \cref{sec:baselines}); the post-test maximum favors the baselines and is not a validation-selected winner.\par
SCG (valA): the standardized gap on validation (valA), computed before the test pass. Spearman between it and the test gain (H2): $\rho$ = 0.782; between test SCG and the test gain (H3): $\rho$ = 0.908 (\cref{sec:SCG-results}).\par
Possible pretraining overlap is discussed in \cref{sec:hosts}. Absolute AUROCs are not comparable with the ResNet-12 tables.\par
\end{minipage}
